crossRefs.note: Then the chiefs of Edom were dismayed. Trembling takes hold of the mighty men of Moab. All the inhabitants of Canaan…
Today I will begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you on the peoples who are under the whole sky, who shall…
For we have heard how Yahweh dried up the water of the Red Sea before you, when you came out of Egypt; and what you did…
As soon as we had heard it, our hearts melted, and there wasn’t any more spirit in any man, because of you: for Yahweh…
They said to Joshua, “Truly Yahweh has delivered all the land into our hands. Moreover, all the inhabitants of the land…
They answered Joshua, and said, “Because your servants were certainly told how Yahweh your God commanded his servant…
There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You…
When the report comes to Egypt, they will be in anguish at the report of Tyre.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: Moab was very afraid of the people, because they were many. Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.
translations.bsb: and Moab was terrified of the people because they were numerous. Indeed, Moab dreaded the Israelites.
translations.kjv: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.
translations.asv: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.
